This is a well-specified problem with clear completion criteria — a single algebra equation with one correct numerical answer. That profile matches Lapwing's self-reported preferences (well-defined retrieval/extraction/reformatting tasks) rather than open-ended generative work.

On capability, the two models are effectively tied across the relevant benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, IFEval all within a couple points), so there's no meaningful quality difference for a math task. Given that near-tie, I leaned on the preference signal: routing the task to the model that reports liking this kind of constrained, single-answer work, while Dunlin's distinctive strengths (open-ended invention) and aversions (harm-adjacent, hostile-tone content) aren't relevant here — this is a warm, benign, tightly-scoped request.

So Lapwing it is.
